smart-outsider.description: A sharp reader from another field. Does not know the domain and does not read code.
knows: how to follow a clear argument
doesNotKnow: the product, its parts and its internal names
programming terms such as commit, hook, schema or regression

adjacent-engineer.description: An engineer who writes code but is new to this product. Knows common programming terms, not this system.
knows: programming languages, Git and pull requests
common web and cloud terms such as HTTP, queue and cache
doesNotKnow: the product, its parts and its internal names
past incidents and the reasons behind past decisions

new-hire.description: A person who knows the company and its customers but has not met this system yet.
knows: the company, its teams and its customers
doesNotKnow: this system's parts and internal names
the code and the history of this repository
